**3B.8 Research Note: Olaf Scholz in 2024**

**Assessment:** The evidence is **moderately positive**. I found multiple signs that Scholz allowed dissent, media criticism, and anti-extremist civil society activity to continue without broad retaliation. The main counterweights are an overbroad BND surveillance framework found unconstitutional in part and the Taurus leak, which increased security tension. I did **not** find reliable evidence of a systematic crackdown on protest or community organization.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| **Against hatred - For humanity and order** | Bundesregierung | 20 Jan 2024 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/kanzler-kompakt-against-hatred-for-humanity-and-order-2254034 | Scholz explicitly urged unity, tolerance, and opposition to right-wing extremism, and defended Germany’s migrant-background population as part of the country. This is evidence that dissenting or minority civic life was not being broadly chilled by official rhetoric. | **3B.8**, also **3B.3**, **3B.7** |
| **Scholz mahnte mehr Meinungsvielfalt in Medien an** | Reuters / onvista | 3 Jun 2024 | https://www.onvista.de/news/2024/06-03-scholz-mahnt-mehr-meinungsvielfalt-in-medien-an-0-20-26278418 | Scholz argued for more factual reporting and more diversity in newsroom voices, including more women, East Germans, and people with migrant backgrounds. This is direct evidence against hostility toward journalists or media pluralism. | **3B.8** |
| **Germany cannot accept spying, says Scholz after suspected China spy arrested** | Reuters / Investing.com | 24 Apr 2024 | https://uk.investing.com/news/world-news/germany-cannot-accept-spying-says-scholz-after-suspected-china-spy-arrested-3451540 | Scholz said Germany would not accept foreign spying and wanted those responsible prosecuted, while avoiding prejudgment during legal proceedings. That is due-process framing, not arbitrary intimidation or retaliation against dissent. | **3B.8**, also **3B.5**, **3B.4** |
| **Olaf Scholz condemns attacks on politicians after third assault in a week** | The Guardian | 8 May 2024 | https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/may/08/olaf-scholz-condemns-attacks-on-politicians-after-third-assault-in-a-week | Scholz condemned assaults on elected officials as outrageous and cowardly and pushed for greater protection. This supports a permissive environment for peaceful political participation rather than a retaliatory one. | **3B.8** |
| **Germany treated intercepted Taurus discussion as a security incident** | AP | 4 Mar 2024 | https://apnews.com/article/russia-germany-ukraine-taurus-missiles-recording-de408772f1edf3bd2f98fd5a3f64da3c | The defense ministry investigated a major security leak and moved to counter targeted disinformation. This is a negative counterweight because the incident increased tension and could chill official communications, though the response was institutional rather than retaliatory. | **3B.8**, also **3B.5**, **3B.6** |
| **BVerfG: BND surveillance powers partly unconstitutional** | Bundesverfassungsgericht | 8 Nov 2024 | https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2024/bvg24-093.html | The Court found parts of BND strategic-surveillance law unconstitutional and said oversight was inadequate. This is the strongest structural counterweight: it shows an overbroad surveillance framework still existed, even if not clearly used by Scholz to target peaceful dissent. | **3B.8**, also **3B.5**, **3B.6** |
| **Bundeswehr mission evaluation** | Federal Foreign Office / Federal Ministry of Defence | 26 Jun 2024 | https://www.auswaertiges-amt.de/en/newsroom/news/2664958-2664958 | The government carried out a first overarching evaluation of Bundeswehr missions abroad using uniform criteria and identified improvement needs. This is indirect but relevant evidence of administrative review rather than arbitrary coercion or unchecked security power. | **3B.8**, also **3B.4**, **3B.5** |

**Bottom line**
- I found **no reliable evidence** that Scholz retaliated against peaceful protest, dissent, or community organization in 2024.
- The record leans toward **permitting pluralism** and using law-based responses to security problems.
- The main caution is the **BND surveillance ruling**, which shows a real oversight problem in the system and a potential chilling-risk background, even if not a clear case of personal repression.

**Search gap**
- I did not find a strong 2024 example of protest bans, selective punishment of activists, or retaliation against civil society attributable to Scholz personally.
- The evidence base is mostly about media pluralism, anti-extremism, and due process, not about direct protest repression.
